items.headline: Kessinger's 4 FGs, Kim's TD pass push Eastern Michigan over Akron 25-23
items.description: — Rudy Kessinger made four field goals, including a 48-yarder with 1:50 remaining, and Noah Kim threw for 277 yards and a touchdown as Eastern Michigan rallied past Akron 25-23 on Saturday.
